limitations.note: The rewrite aligns the two outputs but misses the required timing: `number` should register the pre-edge value of `num`, not publish the increment or load on the same edge.
The rewrite changes `zero` during asynchronous reset from 0 to 1, although the correct fix preserves the original reset value.
The test expects each load value on the very edge that accepts it, so its PASS validates the rewrite’s assumption rather than checking the required one-cycle output delay.
